scope: Exploratory causal packet-window DEVELOPMENT only. No final freeze, unseen-family result, live delay, denial-impact or broad-generalization claim.
group_ownership: Exact 56-group whitelist once; no packet/feature/fitted state crosses roles. Entire Friday target T and entire provided CIC2019 03-11 V.

validation_positive_context.use: Only scores from already permitted whole-V features for preceding decision history. Unknown labels remain -1; they never fit models/maps, enter negatives, or gain labels.

fitting.supervised: Only T known benign+known attack; inverse class frequency weights for HGB, balanced LR/RF.
fitting.anomaly: Only benign T fits IF/AE and their transforms; AE epochs selected on benign V only.
fitting.transforms: No fitted transforms from V/C1/C2. Supervised LR signed-log/median/robust fitted on T. IF signed-log/median/robust fitted on benign T. AE frozen BenignAutoencoder with dynamic signed index for reduced schema.

configuration_selection.metric: Mean raw-score AP on exactly 915 known V windows, no unknown windows or onset metrics.
configuration_selection.seeds: Average five seeds for stochastic methods; LR one deterministic fit.
configuration_selection.tie: Configuration order: lower HGB iterations, shallower RF, smaller LR C / IF max_samples.
configuration_selection.qualification: Exploratory only: 44 positive seconds in one sparse source, source/class/path confounded. Not an independent estimate after selection; does not resolve representativeness.

scoring.single_methods: Raw native anomaly/positive-probability scores, high means attack. Rate packets_in; IF negative score_samples.
scoring.hybrid: HGB and AE right empirical percentiles on disjoint known benign C1, max fusion; preserve ties and saturation at 1; no tail extrapolation.
scoring.branch_controls: Mapped HGB-only and mapped AE-only at the chosen hybrid persistence, recalibrated C2; distinguish mapping effects from branch removal.

persistence.comparison: Strict score > tau; kth-largest trailing h statistic > tau.
persistence.resets: Every group reset; nonconsecutive model-table times invalidate history, never compress/zero-fill gaps.
persistence.C2: Only trailing h consecutive known-benign model windows count. Initial h-1 and every incomplete history excluded; no warm-up labels inferred.
persistence.V_positive: Current corroborated positive only; prior complete-clock scores may have unknown labels in permitted full V source. Does not turn unknowns into ground truth.
persistence.V_negative: Trailing h known-benign windows. Rule-selection FPR tie-break uses common 5-window known-benign support for comparable denominators.
persistence.selection: Max mean V proxy positive-window recall, then min mean common-support benign V FPR, then candidate order 1/1,2/3,3/5. No episode/delay selection.

calibration.groups: All benign C2 whole groups; require nonempty overall, ordinary/stress and every condition stratum.
calibration.threshold: Max of each stratum order statistic at n-floor(alpha*n)-1, with strict comparison; retain ties. n<100 requires zero exceedances.
calibration.guarantee: Empirical eligible-window budget only. No population/final FPR guarantee; unsupported strata fail; zero attack recall/infinite-equivalent cutoff retained.

sensitivity_controls.fit: Same chosen HGB config, AE settings and permitted T; fixed primary method rule, fresh C1/C2 calibration; diagnostic only.
Remove public benign T only; retain whole positive T; no role reassignment. Same chosen config/rule, fresh benign transforms/C1/C2; diagnostic only.

configuration_budget: At most 12 per learned family including score/rule controls: main HGB 3*3 +2 fixed-rule source controls +1 mapped branch; other families no larger. No sensitivity variant promoted by outcomes.
report: All candidates/seeds/thresholds/stratum denominators, source-condition FPR, V labelled-window metrics and mapped saturation. No episode CIs or independent-attack counts; five seeds are algorithm repeats, not traffic recordings.
artifact_policy: Ignored data/packet_model_development_v1 holds weights/references/scores and hashes; public small results/manifests only. Source/data changes fail; no silent overwrite/retraining.
reserved: All lab attack and final benign sessions
